abort.already_in_progress: A setup is already in progress for this integration

error.cannot_connect_slots: Bluetooth adapter or proxy has no free connection slots and the controller is not visible in discovery. Wait and retry, close other mobile apps using the controller, check Settings → Bluetooth → Connection monitor, or add a Bluetooth proxy closer to the controller.

user.title: Controller setup
user.description: Select the controller or enter its Bluetooth MAC address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF), then choose the physical station count. Watering programs run on the controller, including when Home Assistant is offline.

reconfigure.description: Update the station count. To replace the physical controller, remove and add the integration again.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name} and choose the number of stations.

error.invalid_program: Check the schedule values and try again.
error.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded yet.
error.set_program_failed: Failed to update the selected program.
error.set_program_while_watering: Program schedules cannot be changed while watering is active.
error.rainfall_baseline: Refresh programs and confirm their current normal budgets before enabling rainfall adjustment. Resolve any uncertain write first.
error.stale_program: The controller changed since this draft was opened. Cancel and reopen the editor before saving.
error.uncertain_write: The write could not be confirmed. Refresh and review current device programs before making further edits.
error.station_name_uncertain: This save could not be verified. Close and reopen the editor to read the controller again. If prompted, review and accept its current names before saving again.
error.stale_station_name: Names changed on the controller. Close and reopen this editor before saving.
error.invalid_station_name: Enter a non-empty name of at most 32 UTF-8 bytes, without NUL characters.
error.station_name_failed: Could not rename the station. The controller must be idle and use BL-IP firmware 5.x; check Bluetooth connectivity.

init.description: Adjust connection options, onboard programs, station names, and rainfall adjustment.
init.title: Solem BL-IP options

program_select.description: Choose the on-device program to edit.
program_select.title: Edit on-device schedule

program_edit.description: Update {program}. Blank start times are disabled. The controller is written only after you submit this form.
program_edit.title: Edit on-device schedule

rainfall.title: Rainfall adjustment
rainfall.description: Select only lawn programs. Baselines must match their normal device budgets. Rainfall is an accumulated rolling 24-hour total in mm. Saved reductions persist offline. A one-day delay pauses every program; its countdown follows the controller firmware. Validate device budget and delay behaviour before enabling automatic updates.

data.automatic: Apply hourly while Home Assistant is running
data.whole_controller_delay: Allow whole-controller one-day rain delay for complete skips

station_select.title: Rename onboard stations
station_select.description: Choose a station using its current name stored on the controller.

data.accept_current: I have reviewed and accept the current names after the interrupted save

station_name.title: Rename station {station}
station_name.description: Save the name on the controller so it is available in MySOLEM. Names can use up to 32 UTF-8 bytes (accented characters may use more than one byte). Home Assistant entity IDs and custom label overrides are preserved.

abort.program_read_failed: Could not read complete onboard programs. Check the controller connection and try again.
abort.station_names_read_failed: Could not read all station names. Check Bluetooth connectivity and try again.

controller_off_days.name: Turn off controller for selected days

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the controller over Bluetooth.

start_irrigation_failed.message: Failed to start irrigation on station {station}.

controller_on_failed.message: Failed to turn the controller on.

controller_off_failed.message: Failed to turn the controller off.

controller_off_days_failed.message: Failed to turn the controller off for the selected number of days.

set_program_failed.message: Failed to update {program_name} on the controller.

set_program_while_watering.message: Program schedules cannot be changed while watering is active.

service_device_not_found.message: Could not find the selected Solem BL-IP controller.

bluetooth_unavailable.title: Bluetooth connection unavailable
bluetooth_unavailable.description: Home Assistant could not reliably poll controller {mac} over Bluetooth. Check that the controller is powered on, in range, and not connected to another app. If it connects through a Bluetooth proxy, rebooting the proxy typically resolves it; otherwise restarting Home Assistant reloads the Bluetooth adapter.

set_program.name: Edit onboard program
set_program.description: Apply supplied fields to a freshly read program. Omitted settings are preserved.

revision.name: Revision
revision.description: Program revision from the controller status sensor when this draft was opened.

accept_current_programs.name: Accept current programs
accept_current_programs.description: Read and accept current device settings after reviewing an uncertain write. Does not write to the controller.

apply_rainfall.name: Apply rainfall adjustment
apply_rainfall.description: Apply the configured rainfall discount to selected onboard programs.
